items.q: And I would walk out and look at the house, you know. And I just said, 'Well, at least I saw the house where he was born in Florence, Alabama.'

ctx.x: One tune in particular -- one town in particular we played in was Florence, Alabama. Florence was across the Tennessee River from Sheffield, Alabama. and in Florence there was a pool hall where we used to go and hang out and play pool
in the afternoons. And there was a house next door to the pool hall. And this house was where W. C. Handy was born. Florence, Alabama.
And I would walk out and look at the house, you know. And I just said, 'Well, at least I saw the house where he was born in Florence, Alabama.'
